default_policy.custom_hosts: deny-by-default for bootstrap; optional note translation delegates transport to the installed Codex CLI after an explicit content opt-in
default_policy.review_rule: Confirmed bootstrap may download pinned runtime assets. A separate localize_notes translate command may send selected footnote text to the chosen Codex model only after --allow-cloud-translation. Conversion jobs are offline.
default_policy.runtime_enforcement: For direct GitHub assets, bootstrap enforces the declared redirect hosts and complete-file SHA-256. PyPI and Hugging Face installs are forced to their declared official endpoints with inherited indexes, endpoints, credentials, and proxies removed; this is endpoint binding, not an OS host allowlist. The 109 package versions are locked without per-wheel hashes, and four selected model weight files receive exact post-download hashes. On the supported macOS host, every conversion-time Calibre, Docling, Java, and PDF probe subprocess is wrapped by sandbox-exec with deny network*. Resource preflight is defense in depth. Bootstrap is the only direct-download entrypoint; optional note translation is a separate explicit content-scoped delegation to the installed Codex CLI.

scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py.purpose: Download fixed, hash-verified Calibre, EPUBCheck, Temurin, CPython, and official Docling model assets after explicit approval.
scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py.redirect_policy: Direct downloads may redirect only from github.com to release-assets.githubusercontent.com; all direct files must still match fixed SHA-256 values.
scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py.package_index_policy: uv is forced to https://pypi.org/simple with inherited indexes, credentials, endpoints, and proxies removed.
scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py.model_endpoint_policy: HF_ENDPOINT is forced to https://huggingface.co, Xet is disabled, and inherited HF credentials/endpoints/proxies are removed.

scripts/localize_notes.py.purpose: Translate only selected pending footnote groups through an ephemeral schema-constrained Codex CLI turn.
scripts/localize_notes.py.allowed_service: installed Codex CLI managed OpenAI transport
scripts/localize_notes.py.host_policy: not hard-coded here because the installed Codex client owns authenticated transport; this exception is command- and content-scoped rather than a general host allowlist
scripts/localize_notes.py.input_transport: JSON on stdin; never command-line arguments
scripts/localize_notes.py.output_policy: exact JSON Schema plus key-completeness validation
scripts/localize_notes.py.auth: existing local Codex authentication; the Skill does not read, export, copy, or serialize credentials
scripts/localize_notes.py.ordinary_conversion_impact: none; ebook_to_kindle.py remains wrapped in deny network*

scripts/send_to_kindle.py.purpose: Upload one finished file to Amazon Send to Kindle through the user's logged-in local Ego browser, then optionally push that one document to one named device.
scripts/send_to_kindle.py.auth: existing browser session; the script never reads or stores Amazon cookies

scripts/send_to_kindle_email.py.purpose: E-mail one EPUB/PDF/DOCX to the user's own Send-to-Kindle address.
scripts/send_to_kindle_email.py.auth: SMTP app password from ~/.config/kindle/email_config.json (mode 0600) or KINDLE_SMTP_PASS
